AN AVYUHA PRODUCT

Simple date tools, built for practical work.

DayFinder by Avyuha brings everyday calendar calculations into one fast, private and accessible toolkit.

What it is

A collection of ten browser-based utilities for weekdays, ages, date ranges, working days, schedules, ISO weeks, leap years and printable calendars.

Who it helps

Students, teachers, HR and payroll staff, project managers, researchers, event planners, logistics teams, legal administrators and families can use the tools for routine planning.

How it works

Calculations run locally with standard JavaScript date logic and DayFinder’s tested Gregorian date engine. No sign-in or server calculation is required.

Important limitation

DayFinder is an informational planning tool. Verify dates against official sources for legal, payroll, banking, historical or safety-critical decisions.
